layout.container: container-type: inline-size; container-name: app on the app root

phone.tabBar: sticky bottom, 5 equal slots: Home, Review (badge), Add (centre, 52px), Accounts, More; padding 8px 8px calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))

desktop.rail: sticky, surface, right hairline, padding 22px 14px; brand, Add transaction (44px), Home, Review, Accounts, Cards & loans, Reports, Settings at foot
desktop.main: padding 8px 32px 40px; review grid 1.2fr / 1fr gap 24px (card + actions | Up next queue); keyboard hints C/I/U; month spending
desktop.aside: padding 22px 24px 40px; left hairline; background color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg) 60%, var(--surface)); Due soon, Accounts

semantics.expense: Ink colour, U+2212 minus sign, 'Money out' label with arrow-up-right icon.
semantics.income: --income colour, '+' sign, 'Money in' label with arrow-down-left icon. Exception: on Monochrome's inverted front card income uses --bg (sign, word and icon still carry it).
semantics.owed: Absolute amount in ink plus a muted 'owed' label; never danger.
semantics.overdue: Row border --danger; tile filled --danger with #FFFFFF (light) / #1A0806 (dark) text; circle-alert icon plus words ('1 day late') in --danger 600.
semantics.duplicate: Flag on --danger-soft with ink text, copy icon in --danger, bold 'Possible duplicate.' lead.
semantics.estimate: Muted 12.5px caption with trending-up icon; text ends with 'Estimate.'
semantics.money: ₱, en-PH grouping, two decimals (spending legend drops '.00'), tabular numerals; hero cents at 0.5em.

signatures.sakura: Asymmetric petal-cut radii on card, control, tile and institution badge; nine --s2 petals drift on Confirm (1.6s).
signatures.strawberry: Milk carton: 2px --line-strong borders on card, buttons, due tile; 6px 0-blur carton ledge in --card-shadow (kept deliberately); pill controls; chip on --accent-soft; primary button border accent mixed 68% with black.
signatures.bubblegum: Die-cut stickers (intentional): 0 0 0 3px #fff ring plus drop on chip, due tile, review count; tilts chip -3deg, tiles -4deg / 3deg (even tiles --s4), count 6deg; chip on --s5.
signatures.barako: Receipt edge: front card bottom masked with radial-gradient(circle 7px at 50% 100%) every 18px; stamp due tile 46px round, 2px border + 1px outline offset 3px in currentColor, rotate(-6deg), Young Serif digits; italic source line.
signatures.courtside: Scoreboard due tile (--tile-bg dark, --tile-ink amber, inset 2px #2C3038 frame, digit glow 0 0 10px rgb(255 176 32 / .55), overdue #FF5A4E on #000); court-line section rule: 2px --accent line with a 16px centre circle; type 30 / 34 / 54px.
signatures.denim: Stitched seam: 1.5px dashed --stitch inset 6px at .8 opacity on front card and month card; flat leather patch due tile (--tile-bg #8B5A2B, radius 8px) with one 1.5px dashed #E8C38E stitch line at outline-offset -5px; Archivo at 115% width on headings, 112% on tile digits.
signatures.mono: Front review card inverts (ink fill, --bg text); --card-shadow none; amount 52px -0.04em; month 32px; spending bar square, 10px.
signatures.coal: Flat brass plate: --brass-2 fill, inset 0 0 0 1px --brass-3, --brass-ink Marcellus text on due amounts (14px, 3px radius, 3px 9px padding), review count, primary button, centre Add. No faked metal; --brass-1 unused. Due tile outlined in --accent.

narrative.overview:
Budget has one body and eight sets of clothes. The shell (layout, navigation, controls, the review inbox, the due list, every semantic rule) is identical in every theme. A theme lends only four things: its type, its palette, its density, and one signature move. Switching from Sakura to Courtside should feel like the same app dressed for a different person, never like a different app. That is how "personal" (PRODUCT.md principle 5) stays compatible with "review, don't type": the muscle memory never moves.

The surface is a phone-first working inbox, not a dashboard. Home leads with the stack of captured transactions waiting for a tap; only the front card is lifted, everything else sits flat on hairlines. Money is set large in the theme's display or amount face with tabular numerals, and signs, words and icons carry meaning before colour does. Density is comfortable and thumb-led: 52px controls, 16px gutters, 28px between sections.

Themes are tokens on `[data-theme="<id>"]` with a `[data-mode="dark"]` overlay; the frontmatter records every resolved value per theme and mode as `<theme>-<mode>-<role>`, and `.impeccable/design.json` (`extensions.themeVariables`) carries the same values as raw declaration blocks ready to paste into `globals.css`. Themes are never labelled by gender.
keyCharacteristics: One shared shell; a theme changes type, palette, density and one signature move, nothing structural.
Review inbox first: one lifted card, one decision, Confirm in thumb reach.
Signed, worded money: "−" for expenses in ink, "+" for income in the income colour, plus a "Money in / Money out" label with an arrow icon.
Every theme ships light and dark; text role pairs (ink, muted, accent, income, danger on their surfaces, on-accent on accent, tile ink on tile) clear WCAG AA 4.5:1 in all sixteen.
Container-query layout: one tree that becomes a three-column desktop at 760px of app width.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Direction of money is carried by sign, word and icon first. Expenses: ink colour, "−" (U+2212, not a hyphen), "Money out" with arrow-up-right. Income: `--income` colour, "+", "Money in" with arrow-down-left. A colour-blind user reading any theme in greyscale must lose nothing.

rules.name: The Debt Is Not Red Rule
rules.body: Owed balances on credit, BNPL and loan accounts are shown as the absolute amount in ink with a small muted "owed" label. Danger is reserved for things that need action now (overdue, possible duplicate), never for "this is a debt".

rules.name: The Role, Not Hex Rule
rules.body: Components reference role variables only. A new theme is a new value set for the same 23 roles; a new component never introduces a theme-specific colour outside the signature block.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every amount, count and date digit uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. Pesos are written ₱ with en-PH grouping and always two decimals; only the spending legend drops a trailing ".00".

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, labels and group names are sentence case at their natural size. No uppercase eyebrows or kickers above headings; group labels ("Cash & e-wallets") are 13px muted 600, nothing more.

rules.name: The Thumb Rule
rules.body: On phone, Confirm, Add and the active decision are always in the bottom half; nothing that confirms or adds money lives in the top bar.

rules.name: The Due Before Spent Rule
rules.body: Due soon always comes before spending: directly after the inbox on phone, at the top of the right column on desktop.

rules.name: The One Lifted Card Rule
rules.body: Only the card you are deciding on is lifted. If a new surface wants a shadow, it must be the thing the user acts on next; otherwise it gets a hairline.

rules.name: The Signature Stays Home Rule
rules.body: Hard-edged or ornamental depth (Strawberry's carton ledge, Bubblegum's sticker ring, Courtside's scoreboard glow) belongs to its theme only and never becomes a shared style.

dos: **Do** put every theme value in a CSS custom property on `[data-theme]` / `[data-mode="dark"]` and have components read roles only (`--accent`, `--surface`, `--radius-ctl`, `--card-shadow`).
**Do** write expenses as ink with "−" (U+2212) and income in `--income` with "+", plus the "Money out / Money in" label and arrow icon, everywhere an amount has a direction (card, peek, queue).
**Do** mark overdue with all three: danger colour, the circle-alert icon, and words ("1 day late").
**Do** label every projection with the word "Estimate" and the trending-up icon, in muted caption text.
**Do** switch layout with `@container app (min-width: 760px)`: rail 220px, main fluid, right column 400px; below it, the bottom tab bar with the centre Add.
**Do** keep Strawberry Milk's 6px carton ledge (`--card-shadow` with a 0-blur first layer) as that theme's signature.
**Do** keep Bubblegum's sticker ring and drop shadow; it is intentional.
**Do** keep Coal & Brass's brass as a flat plate (brass-2 fill, brass-3 1px inset edge, brass-ink text) on due amounts.
**Do** keep Denim's leather patch flat with exactly one stitch line.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by collapsing all transitions and the petal drift.
**Do** label demo data as sample data on any preview surface.
donts: **Don't** let a theme change layout, navigation order, control size or semantic rules; a theme lends type, palette, density and one signature move only.
**Don't** convey income, expense or status by colour alone.
**Don't** colour owed balances with danger; use the "owed" label.
**Don't** fake metal in Coal & Brass: no gradients, bevels, highlights or sheen on the brass plate (`--brass-1` stays unused).
**Don't** add more stitch lines, rivets or texture to Denim's patch.
**Don't** carry a theme's signature (carton ledge, sticker ring, scoreboard glow, receipt edge, petal cut) into another theme or into shared components.
**Don't** lift any surface other than the review card with `--card-shadow`.
**Don't** add uppercase eyebrows or kickers above section titles.
**Don't** label or group themes by gender.
